title: Anchor resolves for any feature with a lane record or history file
action: Per U5: widen resolve_anchor's ledger arm — a `.bee/lanes/<feature>.json` record alone (no scribing-run entry required) or ANY file under docs/history/<feature>/ yields an anchor, so a bound feature falling to recency fallback becomes the exception. Preserve the priority order (work-item > history > ledger) and every existing anchor kind's behavior; the digest fallback header keeps naming its reason. Repro first: this session's own case — feature decisions-worktree-door was bound with a lane record present yet the digest printed 'recency fallback (no anchor)'; encode that as the red test, then fix. All three consumers (preamble digest, knowledge context, cell-prepare kctx) inherit via the shared resolver.

truths: A bound feature with only a lane record resolves an anchor and gets a ranked digest
Anchor priority order unchanged for work-item and history arms

artifacts.substantive: ledger arm widened with red-first test

key_links: budget.rs rank path exercises the widened arm
